_comment_externally_connectable: Lets the post-install conversion page on imbue.com hand the X Ads click ID (twclid) to the extension via chrome.runtime.sendMessage, so the backend can later report an activation-level ad conversion (first filter job). Not a permission: triggers no install/update warning. Chrome-only — Firefox/Safari don't support the key, and the X ads funnel lands on the Chrome Web Store.
_comment_min_version: 137 guarantees wasm JSPI + relaxed SIMD, letting the build ship only litertlm_wasm_internal.* (~21 MB) instead of all four variants (~105 MB). Keep in sync with copyLitertlmAssets in build.js.
